llm.summary: This skill is a documentation helper whose broad repo review behavior is disclosed and aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill is for building and reviewing technical documentation, including README/docs trees and governance files such as AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md; the referenced playbooks support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: It asks agents to inventory broad documentation surfaces and may apply high-confidence documentation fixes by default, including governance-file alignment, but those behaviors are described in the workflow and stay within documentation work.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact consists of Markdown instructions, sub-agent prompt files, a YAML UI metadata file, and a static JPEG icon; no install-time scripts, package installation, or hidden execution hooks were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Repo-wide reads of documentation and agent instruction files are broad but proportionate for documentation audits; there is no evidence of credential access, external data transfer, destructive operations, or unrelated system access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can recommend or make persistent repository documentation changes and, in a narrow compatibility case, create a .cursor symlink to .agents; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, with replacement of a real .cursor path requiring user input.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you want an agent to audit or update repository documentation and agent/contributor guidance. Review proposed changes to AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, aliases, and symlinks before accepting them, especially in repositories where agent instructions affect team workflows.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The activation surface is broad for documentation work, so users should invoke it intentionally for docs or governance tasks, but the artifact does not show hidden behavior or purpose-mismatched authority.
